newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK ready to table improved offer in telecom talks.
newsitem.headline: HK ready to table improved offer in telecom talks.

text.p: Hong Kong is prepared to table an improved offer in global talks on basic telecommunications with commitment on international simple resale of fax and data services, Director-General of Trade Alan Lai said on Monday.
That represents some 20 percent of the territory's international traffic and also a significant share in the international market, Lai told a news conference.
Global negotiations to free up the world's basic telecommunications market face a deadline of February 15.
Lai said Hong Kong was taking an active role in the discussion to resolve the technical questions on international services and satellite services.
